commit_message: Agent Core v0.2.22 tests: acceptance coverage and verification

actions.content:
import unittest

from agent_core import AgentController


class AcceptanceContractV0222Tests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_structured_task_requirements_separate_code_and_verification(self):
        task = """### Anforderungen

- Ermittle selbstständig die relevanten Dateien.
- Der Backend-Wert muss auf maximal 120 Zeichen begrenzt werden.
- Der normale Leerzustand muss weiterhin korrekt funktionieren.

### Verifikation

- Eingaben mit genau 120 Zeichen.
- Einen aktiven Filter ohne Treffer.
"""
        code, verification = AgentController._task_acceptance_requirements(task)

        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in code], ["A1", "A2"])
        self.assertIn("maximal 120 Zeichen", code[0]["text"])
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in verification], ["V1", "V2"])

    def test_pass_cannot_skip_canonical_code_requirement(self):
        required = [
            {"id": "A1", "text": "Der Backend-Wert muss auf maximal 120 Zeichen begrenzt werden."},
            {"id": "A2", "text": "Der normale Leerzustand muss weiterhin korrekt funktionieren."},
        ]
        final_files = {
            "query.php": "$q = validierung_text($q, 120);\n",
        }
        checks = [{
            "requirement_id": "A1",
            "requirement": "Backend-Limit",
            "satisfied": True,
            "path": "query.php",
            "evidence": "$q = validierung_text($q, 120);",
            "reason": "Die serverseitige Begrenzung ist direkt sichtbar.",
        }]

        validated, problems = AgentController._validate_acceptance_checks(
            checks,
            final_files,
            required,
        )

        self.assertEqual([item["requirement_id"] for item in validated], ["A1"])
        self.assertTrue(any("A2" in problem for problem in problems))

    def test_behavior_verification_rejects_syntax_only_command(self):
        required = [{"id": "V1", "text": "Einen aktiven Filter ohne Treffer."}]
        successful = [{
            "command": "php -l nav/settings_benutzer.php",
            "output": "exit=0\nSTDOUT:\nNo syntax errors detected in nav/settings_benutzer.php\nSTDERR:\n",
        }]
        claimed = [{
            "requirement_id": "V1",
            "satisfied": True,
            "command": "php -l nav/settings_benutzer.php",
            "evidence": "No syntax errors detected",
            "reason": "Die Datei ist syntaktisch korrekt.",
        }]

        validated, problems = AgentController._validate_acceptance_verifications(
            claimed,
            required,
            successful,
        )

        self.assertEqual(validated, [])
        self.assertTrue(any("Syntax-/Diff-Prüfung" in problem for problem in problems))

    def test_behavior_verification_accepts_real_successful_boundary_test(self):
        required = [{"id": "V1", "text": "Eingaben mit genau 120 Zeichen."}]
        command = "php -r 'assert(strlen(str_repeat(\"x\", 120)) === 120); echo \"case 120 ok\\n\";'"
        successful = [{
            "command": command,
            "output": "exit=0\nSTDOUT:\ncase 120 ok\nSTDERR:\n",
        }]
        claimed = [{
            "requirement_id": "V1",
            "satisfied": True,
            "command": command,
            "evidence": "case 120 ok",
            "reason": "Der erfolgreiche Lauf prüft explizit den 120-Zeichen-Grenzfall.",
        }]

        validated, problems = AgentController._validate_acceptance_verifications(
            claimed,
            required,
            successful,
        )

        self.assertEqual(problems, [])
        self.assertEqual([item["requirement_id"] for item in validated], ["V1"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
